narrative.intro: Maximus Education reported $245M in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Maximus Education holds 6 active awards, with an average award size of $40.9M. Obligations fell 17.0% year over year. Historical obligations show a build from $0 in FY21 to $167M in FY22, then $248M in FY23, $271M in FY24, $295M in FY25, and $245M in FY26. The current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date. The data are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Readers should treat the FY2026 number as a year-to-date snapshot rather than a full fiscal-year total. The profile indicates a peak obligation level of $295M in FY25 followed by the FY26 decline to $245M, with a multi-year growth trend from FY21 through FY25 before the current-year pullback.
